content.text:
**Finding: Compliant** — no redline proposed.

§ 18.1–18.2 (paragraphs p0072–p0073) satisfies the INSURANCE rule at the **preferred** position, not merely the fallback:

| Playbook (preferred) | Document § 18.1 |
|---|---|
| CGL USD 1M/occurrence, 2M aggregate | ✅ Exact match |
| Professional (E&O) USD 2M | ✅ Exact match |
| Cyber/privacy USD 5M | ✅ Exact match |
| Workers' comp as required by law | ✅ Plus employer's liability USD 1M (extra) |
| Certificates on request | ✅ § 18.2 |

Direction check: the obligations run against Vendor (Copperleaf), i.e. in our favour, so there is nothing to push back on. § 18.2 also gives us several terms better than the model language — primary-coverage wording, advance notice of cancellation or material reduction, and express confirmation that insurance does not limit Vendor's liabilities (protecting our indemnity and liability recoveries from being capped at policy limits).
